oneSentenceStory: The customer quickly secures tangible value for their 1,500 expiring points with a single tap, smoothly re-engaging after a period of inactivity.
customerSituation: Customer returns after 41 days of inactivity and discovers 1,500 points are set to expire within 7 days.
storyTension: Risk of losing accumulated value without feeling pressured or bombarded by intrusive alerts.
customerResolution: Customer browses a clean instant reward grid and redeems points for an immediate tangible voucher.
primaryOutcome: Immediate, satisfying claim of instant rewards using expiring points.
